title: Schema-failure replay proxy and lineage tagger for usage events
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: A subset of usage event failures in the ingestion pipeline are nondeterministic or lose context during raiser/consumer handoffs, which makes post-mortem diagnosis and remediation slow. We currently log schema failures, but lack a standardized, replayable envelope that preserves original routing, tenant metadata, and transformation lineage. This ticket implements a lightweight replay proxy and lineage tagger that: 1) captures failed events (schema or enrichment failures) into an immutable replay store with deterministic replay IDs; 2) attaches provenance/lineage tags at each pipeline hop (ingress, normalizer, enricher, validator) so replays reconstruct the processing path; 3) exposes a replay API and CLI for on-demand reprocessing and canary replays into a sandboxed path; 4) supports sampling rules and retention policies to bound cost.
acceptance_criteria: Failed usage events with schema validation errors are persisted to the replay store with a deterministic replay_id and full envelope within 200ms of detection
Every pipeline hop appends a lineage tag (component, version, timestamp, node-id) without changing the event payload semantics
Replay API supports idempotent re-ingest with header overrides (canary route, dry-run, capture-output) and returns structured success/failure reasons
Operators can run targeted replays by filter (replay_id, tenant, time-range, failure-type) and see perf and outcome metrics in Console Observability dashboard
End-to-end latency of the live ingestion path is not regressed by >5% under normal traffic when the replay proxy is active
design_notes: Replay store will be append-only object storage (S3) + small metadata index in Dynamo-like store for fast lookup; metadata includes replay_id (sha256 over envelope+origin+ts), tenant, failure_type, original_topic, size_bytes
Lineage tag format: <component>:<semver>:<node-short>:<ts-utc> ; appended to event.metadata.lineage as an ordered array
We will implement a proxy sidecar (go) for each ingress boundary that intercepts validation failures and posts them to the replay collector asynchronously using bounded in-memory batching
Sampling rules: default 100% for high-severity failures, 1-5% for transiently noisy tenants; adjustable via Console UI or feature flag
Replay API will support a dry-run mode which runs through the normal pipeline but routes outputs to a sandbox sink and records diffs (schema acceptance, enrichment deltas)
Security: persisted envelopes are encrypted with customer KMS keys when tenant is private; metadata index stores minimal PII; access controlled via RBAC
implementation_plan: Week 1: Proto sidecar + replay collector skeleton; define metadata schema and lineage tag spec; unit tests for tag append and deterministic id generation
Week 2: Integrate collector with object store and metadata index; end-to-end dev pipeline to replay into sandbox sink; implement sampling config and admin endpoints
Week 3: Add CLI and Replay API endpoints; build Console integration for listing, filters, and replay controls; performance tuning to ensure <5% latency impact
Week 4: Canary rollout to internal org -> one small tenant -> ramp based on error replay volume; capture metrics and iterate retention/sampling defaults
Post-release: doc runbook for incident responders, follow-up tickets for pruning tool and long-term cold-store lifecycle
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Replay persistence could spike costs if failures surge. Mitigation: implement immediate sampling and emergency rate-limit flags, and a retention TTL default of 30 days
Risk: Lineage tags could cause schema drift if improperly inserted. Mitigation: only mutate metadata.lineage array; do not alter payload keys consumed by downstream validators
Risk: Replays may trigger side effects in downstream systems. Mitigation: default replay route is sandbox; require explicit canary flag for production-targeted replays and enforce RBAC
monitoring_and_diagnostics: New metrics: replay.store.write_latency_ms, replay.store.success_rate, replay.queue.length, replay.replay_success_rate, lineage.append_errors
Dashboards: 'Replay Volume and Outcomes' with tenant breakdowns and recent failure types; 'Lineage Coverage' showing percent of events with >=1 tag by component
Alerts: SLO on replay-store write error rate >1% for 5m; alert for sudden spike (>5x expected) in persisted failures
Audit logs for replay API usage with user, timestamp, target_tenant and dry_run flag
testing_plan: Unit tests for deterministic replay_id generation using fixed envelope fixtures
Integration tests that inject known schema-failure events and validate persisted envelope, lineage tags, and replay dry-run outputs
Load test: simulate 10k failures/min sustained for 10m to validate write throughput and sampling enforcement
Chaos test: simulate object store throttling and ensure backpressure surfaces to operator console and does not silently drop events (fail-open policy is unacceptable)
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only tenants + dev cluster (feature flag enabled) for 1 week
Canary: route 0.5% of production traffic failures through collector for two small tenants; monitor cost and downstream noise
Ramp: increase to 10% governed by replay-store cost and tag coverage metrics; after 2 weeks, enable for all tenants with default sampling
Backout: feature flag off or set sample=0; replay entries left immutable and will be GC'ed per retention policy
